newsitem.title: USA: DIGITAL EQUIPMENT LOOKS TO SELL UNIT - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: DIGITAL EQUIPMENT LOOKS TO SELL UNIT - WSJ.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp is seeking to sell its computer-network equipment business, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the situation.

The paper's electronic edition said the company, which declined to comment on the matter, is seeking to sell the unit in the face of stiffer competition. The company sees the unit as a growing cash drain that would take a huge investment to revive, the paper said the people told it.
Digital's Network Product unit has estimated annual revenue of about $600 million and could fetch between $500 million and $750 million, industry officials said.
The paper said Digital has so far held talks about the unit's sale with Bain Capital Inc and Lucent Technologies.
Industry insiders said Sun Microsystems would be a logical buyer for the business, the paper said.
